widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2d anime style, a medium-wide shot of a crowded outdoor street market in soft morning sunlight, wooden stalls piled high with cabbages, tomatoes, carrots, and daikon radishes under striped canvas awnings, shoppers crowding both sides of the narrow street. In the center, a young woman with shoulder-length brown hair, wearing a navy blue sailor-style high school uniform with a white collar, a red neckerchief, a pleated navy skirt, white socks, and brown loafers, faces a female police officer with short black hair, wearing a light blue short-sleeved uniform shirt, a navy skirt, a navy police cap, and a black belt. The police officer aims a black revolver at the schoolgirl with both hands, arms locked straight out. In a blur of motion, the schoolgirl lunges forward, grabs the barrel of the revolver with one hand, and twists it sideways as she snaps a fast roundhouse kick into the officer's side, wrenching the revolver out of her grip. The camera shakes strongly on impact as the officer is knocked backward off her feet, crashing through a vegetable stall, sending cabbages, tomatoes, and carrots flying high into the air and tumbling across the street, her police cap spinning off her head. The schoolgirl lands in a low fighting stance with the revolver in her hand as nearby shoppers jump back in shock. The camera pushes in at fast speed toward the schoolgirl as the vegetables rain down around her; she turns her head and looks straight into the camera with a cool, confident smirk, raises the revolver beside her face, and pulls back the hammer with her thumb.

overall_soundscape: Morning market bustle and chatter, a sharp grunt and whoosh of the kick, a heavy thud on impact, the loud splintering crash of a wooden stall, vegetables thumping and rolling across the pavement as the crowd gasps, and a crisp metallic click as the revolver's hammer is cocked.

non_diegetic_music: A fast, punchy brass and drum action sting with a sharp cymbal crash on the impact, cutting to silence just before the click.
nodes.title: PROMPT (used everywhere)
int8 video VAE for the final decode
PASS 1 at 0.5 MP: decides layout, acting, audio
MAINodes: where is motion too fast
FAST DE-ROPE: motion gate (finds sustained fast motion; calm clips skip pass 2)
FAST DE-ROPE: the redrawn burst spliced into pass 1
DRAWING SMEAR: one static token per 2s drawing (key poses x2)
FREEZE MASK: lock the splice handles to pass 1 (no ghosting)
FACE ATLAS: every small face magnified into one canvas (+ pinned frame context)
V2V init: redraw only the face tiles, pass-1 audio pinned (lips stay in sync)
redraw depth from face size (tiny faces redraw deeper)
STITCH: faces back into the frames
RELAY: DMAD turbo 0.8 (the take is already fixed)
RELAY: shift for the detail pass
RELAY: FaceDetail atlas scaled to the hires size
RELAY: FaceDetail's face tiles stitched onto the 1920 frames (the final keeps the preview's faces)
H3 RELAY HIRES: AnimeSR -> 1 DMAD step at sigma 0.60 at 1920, audio pinned

widgets_values:
RELAY HIRES, example 3 of 4: + Fast De-rope + FaceDetail.

Small faces in wide shots get only a few 32 px DiT tokens and come out mushy. FaceDetail finds them (anime face detector, CPU), magnifies each into a tile of one canvas and redraws them in one H3 pass at 0.5 MP; faces already big are left alone. After the relay, the same face tiles are stitched onto the 1920 frames, so the final keeps the faces you approved in the preview.

Set the pass-1 size, hires scale and prompt in the blue SETTINGS group. Needs: ComfyUI-H3-FaceDetail, ComfyUI-H3-FastDerope, ComfyUI-H3-RelayHires, ComfyUI-H3-ResCascade, ComfyUI-MAINodes, ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite, comfyui_essentials. Models: MiniMax H3 (int8 DiT, text encoder, fp16 + int8 video VAEs, audio VAE), taeh3, the DMAD 4-step turbo LoRA, FaceDetail's anime face detector (see its README).

Tested: 224 s end to end on an RTX 5090 (5 s clip, 124 frames).
